baseline.toolchain: node 22 / webpack 5 production build (npm run build + npm run copythemes)
baseline.note: Budgets are the measured size plus roughly 10-15% headroom. Raise one only with a recorded reason in docs/performance.md; a bundle that grows past its budget is a product decision, not a build detail.

groups.description: Blazor JS initializer and the bootstrap shim that pulls in the entry bundle.
Interop entry bundle. Loaded on every page that uses a component.
igniteui-webcomponents chunk. The single largest shipped asset.
Third-party license banners emitted alongside the bundles.
Shipped for debuggability. Never requested unless devtools are open, so no gzip budget.
Prebuilt component themes copied from igniteui-webcomponents. Consumers reference one.

totals.description: Worst case over the wire for a page using a themed component.
Everything shipped under _content/IgniteUI.Blazor, including source maps.
